provenance: Authored reconstruction. Layout, dialogue, geometry and encounter values authored here; vanilla progression dependencies checked against the retained Shipwright logic. Not original ROM data.

mouth.name: THE LIVING THRESHOLD
mouth.hint: That pale membrane above the passage reacts to impact. Focus it with Q, then fire a Deku seed with R.

lift.name: THE BREATHING SHAFT
lift.hint: The central fold rises and falls with his breath. Ruto's voice echoes from the chamber beyond it.

holes.name: THE DIVIDED CHAMBER
holes.hint: The princess was here a moment ago. A torn fold leads down into a flooded chamber. The northern passage is choked by a living root.

water.name: THE TIDAL POCKET
water.hint: A pressure nodule on the right raises the water. Speak to Ruto, carry her with E, and bring her back to the upper passages.

fork.name: THE FIVEFOLD PASSAGE
fork.hint: Ruto can hold down the round seal at the eastern door. Set her on it with E. You will need a returning weapon to loosen the roots.

stingers.name: THE SUNKEN NEST
stingers.hint: Stingers hide beneath the shallow membrane, then leap. Avoid their approach and strike after they surface. A thrown princess can also stop them.

west.name: THE WESTERN ROOT
west.hint: Stay just beyond the root's reach. When it stretches toward you, its pale neck is exposed to the boomerang.

bubbles.name: THE AIR SAC
bubbles.hint: Burst the drifting bubbles before the chamber exhales. If time runs out, leave and return for another attempt.

east.name: THE EASTERN ROOT
east.hint: The western root has relaxed this passage. Cut the next constriction to reach the northern chamber.

north.name: THE NORTHERN ROOT
north.hint: Biri gather around the last root. Their electrical charge repels a sword; the boomerang can interrupt it.

octo.name: THE PRINCESS'S STONE
octo.hint: Bring Ruto to the raised seal. The jewel she came to recover lies beyond the constriction.

jigglies.name: THE TREMBLING BRIDGE
jigglies.hint: The living pads repel anyone who touches them. A boomerang settles each pad for a few seconds. Cross while both are quiet.

near_boss.name: THE INNER SEAL
near_boss.hint: A fold shields the last switch from a straight shot. Stand on the left, focus the pale nodule and let the boomerang curve around it.

barinade.name: BIO-ELECTRIC ANEMONE · BARINADE
barinade.hint: Sever the three ceiling connections with the boomerang. Break through the circling Biri, stun the exposed body, then use your sword.

ruto.first: You followed my letter? I did not ask for a guard! Something inside Lord Jabu-Jabu has taken my mother's stone. I am going to get it back.
ruto.rescue: The current brought me down here. If you insist on helping, carry me. Put me down before drawing a weapon, and do not leave me behind!
ruto.carry: E lifts or sets Ruto down. T throws her forward. Keep her clear of enemies and carry her through the passages.
ruto.altar: There! Mother's stone! Set me on that seal. I can reach it from there.
ruto.reward: You came back for me, even when the whole chamber shook. Take the Zora's Sapphire. My mother entrusted it to me, and now I am trusting you. Remember that promise.
